description: Read a stored user-connection plan without writes or browser prompts. Follow nextAction: resume_reference_setup continues the same approved plan's unattempted reference step; check_status permits bounded read-only rechecking; inspect_connection stops automatic actions; use_platform_setup means the connector needs the Copilot Studio UI. Only ready/continue_request with both verified binding names completes a stored plan, including Agent Node connections. Never poll indefinitely, retry an uncertain write, or send credentials to chat.
